purpose: Registry of non-affiliated authoritative sources these publications are permitted to cite.
why: Before this registry every outbound link on all three publications pointed at a domain inside the network, and all 543 affiliated links carry rel="sponsored nofollow" by design. A publication that cites only itself and passes no equity looks exactly like a link farm and gives an answer engine no reason to treat it as a source. These entries are the outside evidence the pages stand on.

rules.verification: Every entry was fetched over the network and returned HTTP 200. An entry may not be added from memory. If a URL cannot be verified it is not listed, and the page states what is unknown instead of citing it.
rules.no_rel_sponsored: These are editorial citations, not affiliated placements. They must NOT carry rel="sponsored" - that would misdeclare an unpaid citation of a government agency as a paid placement. The sponsored+nofollow rule applies to affiliated network targets only.
rules.lane_separation: A source may only be cited by the publications listed in its `lanes`. The professional publication additionally separates its subject areas, so `topics` are used to keep equine, workplace mental-health, immigration, and regulated-clinic material from citing each other's sources.
rules.stability: Entries use the URL the server actually resolved to, so a citation does not open on a redirect.
